resolution.description: `external` is a human's declaration and is valid only on a confirmed record; a scanner may never propose it (ADR-18).

confidence.description: Per-inference (ADR-2, ADR-28). Optional on a record: present when a scan inference produced it, absent when a human wrote it.

recordValue.description: Equal to its own ASCII-stripped form, and free of ASCII control characters U+0000-U+001F and U+007F (ADR-32).

state.description: Exactly two stored states. `drifted` is derived at read time, never stored (ADR-11).

description: The readable contract. Enforcement lives in tools/steward/manifest.py, which is hand-written and dependency-free (ADR-1: zero third-party dependencies, so no JSON-Schema evaluator is vendored). A test asserts this document's `properties` and the validator's TOP_LEVEL_KEYS match, which is the drift guard between the two.

$schema.description: Relative path to this file inside the target repo.

commands.description: The approved command set. C1's only claim source (ADR-32).

docsScope.description: The declared documentation scope (C3, C4, the indexes).

frontmatterSchema.description: A required-key list plus one optional boolean, and nothing else (ADR-31). Unknown frontmatter keys pass silently; no value is ever type- or format-checked.

intentionallyEmpty.description: One record per legitimately empty declared scope, keyed per scope (ADR-30). A record clears the vacuity error for its key only.

paths.description: The declared path list. C2's only claim source (ADR-32).

recorded.description: The paths the-steward created, each with its kind and the digest of the whole file as we last wrote it. The manifest never records itself (ADR-2).

kind.description: rendered: a renderer produced it, so C4 can re-render it. copied: vendored bytes, never re-rendered, never in the corpus.

pending.description: Re-scan deltas. A re-scan may not mutate a matching confirmed record (ADR-11).
